goku.source: Sketchfab "Goku model rig" by Oup77, https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/goku-model-rig-75b88c3bf6a446df87680b8e7d4ba8e0, CC BY 4.0, downloaded through the Sketchfab API with the owner's token and repacked losslessly by scripts/pack-gltf-to-glb.mjs: geometry, skin weights, inverse bind matrices, UVs and textures unchanged.
goku.creator: Oup77 (Sketchfab)
goku.notes: VERIFIED PLAYABLE BODY. 73 joints, 19/19 canonical roles, 77,860 triangles, 21,713 weighted vertices, two 2048x2048 diffuse maps. Materials were converted from KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness to core metallic-roughness by scripts/convert-specgloss-to-pbr.mjs: three.js no longer implements the spec/gloss extension, which is why this body rendered pure white in a live match. Motion is 46 clips authored on this exact skeleton by scripts/author-goku-clips.mjs (grounded via measured forward kinematics, two-handed Kamehameha solved with scripts/probe-goku-pose.mjs). Blender cannot pose this skeleton without rebuilding it (bone heads import 95 m from a 1.9 m mesh), so three-phase animation evidence is captured in the runtime; see scripts/verify-goku-hd-match.mjs and artifacts/goku-hd/. The previous 19-bone original body remains registered as goku_roster19 for rollback.

naruto_uzumaki.creator: ronildo.facanha
naruto_uzumaki.notes: IMPORTED body, not a repository-generated stand-in. Downloaded 2026-11-06 from the project folder published in the description of Sketchfab model b650b60a7bbd4f11b05a435e65116168 (CC BY 4.0). The package is one FBX holding Naruto and Sasuke on separate 567-bone Rigify rigs plus external PNGs. assets/blender/naruto_from_fbx.py keeps Naruto, rebuilds each material around its supplied texture, removes the inverted-hull ink shell (glTF cannot mark it back-side, so it rendered the body as a black silhouette) and normalises the 6.15 m source to 1.80 m. assets/blender/naruto_animations.py adds 19 clips authored on this rig. Geometry 3,989 tris after the outline strip, 5 materials with 5 embedded PNGs (tex01 922x922, tex02 922x922, face 128x128 from smiling.png, hands 64x64, palms 64x64). Fan-made art of a copyrighted character: CC BY covers the creator's work only and does not clear Naruto franchise rights, so it is local-prototype-only. Evidence, source package and digests: artifacts/asset-fetch/naruto_sasuke/ and artifacts/naruto-roster/.

NO animation clips yet: motion comes from the runtime canonical motion sets, so every gameplay state still needs authored clips before this can be promoted. Stylised low-detail materials, not HD. Review with ?showcaseCharacter=goku_licensed.
